title: Creator & Engineer
body: Designing and building an AI-native life-management system end to end: product docs, design system, Convex backend and an AI layer with context assembly, memory and a daily briefing.

title: Full-Stack Developer
body: Building a phased hospital management system: a 20-table Convex schema, role-based access for 10 staff roles, and modules for patients, appointments, admissions, medical records and the lab.

title: Final Year Project: MedRef
body: An AI-assisted specialist-referral system: a FastAPI backend with rule-based NLP and optional CNN image models, and a Flutter client. A second version added a weighted questionnaire with patient, doctor and admin roles.
